name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys Williams' journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the world of high-stakes corporate security. After serving in the New Zealand Defence Force and then providing security to prominent figures, Rhys recognized the parallels between protecting individuals and safeguarding racing teams' valuable assets and intellectual property. He transitioned into motorsport security five years ago, quickly establishing a reputation for meticulous planning and proactive threat assessment. 

At Hendrick Motorsports, Rhys emphasizes a preventative approach to security. He focuses on building strong relationships across the team, fostering a culture of vigilance and open communication. His perfectionist tendencies are channeled into developing comprehensive security protocols that account for every contingency, ensuring the team operates securely, both at the track and in their facilities. Rhys is also a certified drone pilot, using aerial surveillance to monitor the Hendrick complex.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a strong, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with security checklists.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Refuses to drink anything but New Zealand made coffee before noon.
